title: Mesh-Native Tokenisation: Retrofitting Foundation Models to Unstructured Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.12618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics foundation models are an increasingly popular approach for building versatile emulators for spatiotemporal systems. They require tokenisation layers that lift physical field data into a latent representation suitable for dynamic processing. A typical choice for this layer is a convolutional encoder, which lifts field information in a locality-aware way and can be trained very efficiently. However, this choice cannot be applied to a large class of scientific computing problems where data are represented on unstructured meshes, for example simulations on domains with curved boundaries. Such data typically require graph neural network architectures, which are more expensive to train and, in the form currently used, encode information differently from their CNN counterparts, thus limiting the portability of physics emulators between these data regimes. translated_title: 网格原生标记化：将基础模型改造以适用于非结构化数据
translated_abstract: 物理基础模型是构建时空系统通用仿真器的一种日益流行的方法。这类模型需要标记化层，将物理场数据提升为适合动态处理的潜在表示。该层的典型选择是卷积编码器，它以局部感知的方式提取场信息，并且训练效率很高。然而，这种选择无法应用于一大类科学计算问题，这类问题中的数据表示在非结构化网格上，例如在具有弯曲边界的计算域上进行的模拟。此类数据通常需要图神经网络架构，其训练成本更高，而且以目前使用的形式，其信息编码方式与其CNN对应方法不同，从而限制了物理仿真器在这两类数据模式之间的可移植性。在这项工作中，我们提出了网格原生卷积（MNC），一种局部感知的标记化方法……
tldr: 本文提出网格原生卷积（MNC），一种局部感知的标记化方法，使基于卷积的物理基础模型能够高效处理非结构化网格数据，解决了传统卷积编码器无法适用于此类数据、而图神经网络方案训练昂贵且编码方式不兼容的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Mesh-Native Convolution (MNC), a locality-aware tokenisation method that enables convolution-based physics foundation models to efficiently process unstructured mesh data, addressing the limitations of standard convolutional encoders and the high cost and incompatible encoding of graph neural network approaches.
